## Profile facts (gen1 r1, baseline 807.6 ms q13)
- orders scan + NOT LIKE '%a%b%' filter: 2.58s CPU (largest; 3.04s after E0001)

- SIMD strstr in FindStrInStr (contains.cpp ~line 76; memchr first byte then Contains<> by needle size;
